description: Sets (creates or updates) a custom field value on an inventory item. Provide the inventory item id, the field name (an existing field with that name is reused, otherwise a new field is created for the company), and the value. showInTable is a per-field, company-wide setting: true shows the field as a column in the inventory table for every item, false hides it. Returns the saved field.
name: set_inventory_item_custom_field
